messages:
sara_ng: Heads-up — scheduling a short maintenance window for Dedicated & Private to roll a runtime+kernel patch. target window: 2026-05-12 02:00–03:00 UTC. Affects few customers on older pinned versions.

sara_ng: Need: 1) Status page blurb, 2) CS reply template, 3) rollback criteria we can share with eng. Can someone draft? :pray:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by sara_ng. change_id=chg_20260512_runtime; planned_start=1802007200; estimated_duration=3600s; canary_group=10% (5 hosts).

ellen_cho: I can do the status page short blurb. Propose two lines:
- "We are performing a scheduled runtime upgrade to improve inference stability. Some Dedicated/Private customers using pinned older runtimes may see transient 503s."
- "Start: 2026-05-12 02:00 UTC — ETA 1 hour. Updates every 15 minutes."

mike_r: Add note about fallback: "If degradation is observed, traffic will be routed to compatible model variant with no config changes for customers on Hosted/Dedicated. Private customers can request assistance."

cs_ops: For CS template — keep it short and actionable. Draft: 
"Hi {{customer_name}},
We will be performing a scheduled maintenance on 12 May 2026 02:00–03:00 UTC to apply stability patches to the inference runtime. Impact: potential short request errors (brief 5–15 min spikes) for customers on older pinned runtime versions. No action required if you are on automatic updates.
If you have pinned a runtime and require us to hold or coordinate a specific rollback window, reply and we’ll assist.
Status updates: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/chg_20260512_runtime
Thanks, Redwood Support"

olivia_t: Can we include the rollback policy snippet for transparency? e.g.,
"Rollback criteria:
- Error rate > 3% for 10m on control group
- Median p95 latency regression > 400ms vs baseline
- Any widespread 5xx in >25% of nodes
If hit, deploy will be automatically rolled back and customers notified."

josh_l: Quick technical note for eng: canary uses model-compat routing; if pin prevents fallback, we should notify the customer list flagged in the sheet. also attaching the upgrade checklist in thread: 
```
Checklist: 
- preflight metrics snapshot
- canary deploy (10%)
- 15m stability window
- promote to 50% then 100%
- run smoke evals vs golden prompts
- post-deploy monitoring 2h
- rollback if criteria hit
```

deploy-bot: Canary rolled out to 10% at 1802007500. canary_ok=true, smoke_eval_pass=true.

mike_r: OK to publish the statuspage and CS template. I'll stage the status update now.

cs_ops: Publishing CS template to Zendesk macros and tagging high-touch customers who are pinned. Will send individualized notices where required.

ellen_cho: Statuspage text I pushed: 
"Scheduled maintenance: Runtime upgrade — May 12 02:00 UTC. Some Dedicated/Private users on pinned runtimes may experience brief request failures while kernels are upgraded. We will update this page every 15 minutes."

josh_l: Note for the record: pinned customers list updated at 1802003600. If any customer requests freeze, we will abort promote and keep canary.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 50% at 1802008000. monitoring: error_rate=0.6% (control baseline 0.4%), p95_latency +30ms. continue_monitor=true.

mike_r: Given the small delta, proceed to 100% after 15m if stable.

cs_ops: Sent batch email to pinned customers notifying potential brief impact. Template used (short):
"Subject: Maintenance notice — runtime upgrade (May 12)
Hi {{name}},
We’re applying a runtime stability upgrade on May 12 02:00–03:00 UTC. You may see brief request errors if you’re pinned to an older runtime. No action needed unless you want us to postpone — reply to this message.
Status: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/chg_20260512_runtime
— Redwood Support"

ellen_cho: Final update: Post-deploy monitoring OK. Closing note for status page: "Completed — All systems nominal. If you see any lingering issues please contact support."

sara_ng: Thanks team. Saved the templates to the comms folder and updated the internal runbook with rollback criteria. :clap:
